messages:
amelia: heads-up — planning a slightly different FF rollout for the logging-service deploy in the 02:00 UTC window. want to experiment with a delayed deploy-bot toggle to capture warmup behavior before enabling traffic.

amelia: plan: deploy with flag OFF, deploybot toggles to 1% after +15m, wait 10m -> 10% at +30m -> 100% at +60m if metrics stable. pin old model route for any affected clients.

simon: sounds good. what are our guardrails?

amelia: quick ones: error-rate > 0.8% or p95 latency uplift > 60ms for the cohort => immediate rollback and pin. also if CPU on dedicated pool > 85% for 5m.

marco: can deploy-bot support delayed toggles? last I checked it only supports immediate enable at deploy time.

deploy-bot: @channel scheduled toggle created: toggle_id=tb-6480012345-01; action=enable; flag=logging_service_v2; schedule=+15m->1%, +30m->10%, +60m->100%; rollback_on=[error_rate>0.8,p95_delta>60ms,cpu>85%]; initiator=amelia

jen: Nice, thanks for adding the rollback conditions in the bot. How will we surface the cohort metrics?

qa-bot: will post telemetry snapshots to #eng-releases every 5m during rollout window. alerting rules tied to metric thresholds already configured (alerts:logging_v2_error_rate, logging_v2_p95).

simon: add a small safety window where the toggle pauses if any infra alert fires. we don't want automatic ramp to keep going.

deploy-bot: updated toggle tb-6480012345-01: added pause_on_alert=infra.* and manual_confirm_after_pause=true

marco: also recommend a pin for the routing service: if we need to roll back, pin to logging-service-v1 at the router layer for affected region eu-west-1. ops-oncall, can you pre-create the pin?

ops-oncall: creating pin request now: pin_id=pin-6480012345-eu1; target=router-config-v1; expires=24h; will apply on rollback command.

amelia: included a quick excerpt for release notes — add to the PR: "delayed cohort toggle to gauge cold cache effects and routing stability; safe-guards for rapid rollback."

simon: also add a note to on-call runbook: if toggle pauses, do not force resume. gather logs, run quick test queries against canary cohort, then decide.

jen: can we include the exact deploy command in the notes? so ops can re-run if needed.

amelia: yes: `./deploy --service=logging-service --image=registry/redwood/logging:v2 --ff=logging_service_v2=off` then deploy-bot will do toggles.

marco: making a small telemetry checklist: 1) p50/p95 latency charts, 2) error rate by endpoint, 3) right-sizing GPU/CPU, 4) tail-promises errors. post links in thread when live.

qa-bot: reminder: smoke test script `tests/smoketests/logging_canary.sh` will run against cohort users. it will post results to the thread.

deploy-bot: execution timeline: deploy at 02:00 UTC -> toggle 1% @02:15 -> check @02:20 -> toggle 10% @02:30 -> check @02:40 -> toggle 100% @03:00 (if green).

ops-oncall: confirm I've got runbook steps and pin ready. I also set a manual kill command: `deploy-bot rollback tb-6480012345-01` will re-pin and disable flag.

simon: one more: set a sticky cohort for internal traffic so we can route test users through v2 while external users see v1 until full ramp.

deploy-bot: sticky_cohort added: internal_beta_users (cohort_id=int-b48). will respect sticky sessions for 24h.

amelia: thanks all. I'll push the PR and add the release note lines. please be standby from 01:50 UTC. I'll post when deployment starts. :thumbsup:

marco: I'll watch infra metrics 02:00-03:15. ping me if anything odd.

jen: QA on standby, smoke tests ready.

ops-oncall: on-call monitoring channel open. will escalate if alerts fire.

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled: tb-6480012345-01 will be active in 45 minutes.

amelia: deploying in 5. posting live logs to the thread.

(amelia posts logs)

```
Deploy started: logging-service v2
Image: registry/redwood/logging:v2
FF logging_service_v2=OFF
Containers: 12 -> 12
Healthchecks: passing
```

jen: smoke tests running...

qa-bot: smoke test results: 0 failures (internal cohort), latency p95 = 98ms (baseline 90ms), error rate = 0.12%

marco: infra CPU spikes at 02:08 to 74% — within expected.

deploy-bot: toggle to 1% executed @02:15. cohort=int-b48 + random 1% of traffic.

qa-bot: scheduled telemetry snapshot posted to #eng-releases (02:20): p95 uplift 15ms, error rate 0.15% -> below thresholds.

simon: looks healthy so far. proceed with 10% at +30.

deploy-bot: toggle to 10% executed @02:30.

ops-oncall: alert: logging_v2_p95 triggered at 02:33 (p95 delta 72ms) — pausing rollout.

deploy-bot: rollout paused by alert infra.logging_v2_p95. awaiting manual_confirm_after_pause.

amelia: pausing. can someone grab traces for 02:25-02:35 and share top slow endpoints?

marco: fetching traces now. looks like batch-index endpoint latency spikes. digging into logs.

jen: QA smoke test against the 10% cohort shows occasional timeouts on batch-index. reproducing locally.

simon: decision: do not resume. initiate rollback.

deploy-bot: rollback command received: `deploy-bot rollback tb-6480012345-01` executed @02:38. flag logging_service_v2=OFF; pin applied pin-6480012345-eu1. routing pinned to v1 for eu-west-1.

ops-oncall: pin applied and verified. service traffic reverted.

qa-bot: post-rollback checks: smoke tests OK, p95 back to baseline.

amelia: thanks team. i'll open a follow-up issue for tuning batch-index and we'll try a narrower delayed toggle after fixes. add this to release notes: "rollout paused due to p95 uplift; automatic rollback executed and routing pinned to v1. root cause investigation underway."

simon: add retrospective note: consider starting toggles at 0.5% for this service next time (smaller step).

marco: will add logs/traces to the ticket.

deploy-bot: toggle tb-6480012345-01 closed: reason=rollback by ops; closed_by=simon; closed_at=6480012420

amelia: great work, everyone. follow-up ticket created: #3241. We'll schedule a reattempt after fixes.
